body.x: Another year has passed, bringing us round again to the season of the Korea Electronics Show.

KES 2012, which will be held at KINTEX in Ilsan from October 9 th to the 12 th , is expected to include 800 companies altogether, with 250 companies hailing from outside Korea. With the show scale bordering on off-the-chart massive, there is no doubt that some visitors are having a little trouble figuring out how to get the most bang for their buck. Not to worry! Pay close attention to the articles below, and you’ll able to enjoy 100% - nay, 200% - of what the expo has to offer.

Another good option is downloading the KES 2012 application on your smartphone or tablet PC. Containing all of the information about show events, this application is available as a free download from the Google Playstore and the Apple App Store.

The theme of the 2012 Korea Electronics Show is convergence. True, there are a variety of booths that are prepared for visitors inside the event space including 3D Expo; Multimedia; Broadcasting Equipment; Well-being Electronics; Electronic Parts, Materials, and Equipment; and ICT Solutions. However, for many companies in the show, few products and services set out for display rely on only one kind of technology. In such products, hardware, software, and services previously assumed to be completely unrelated are joined together into one. Discovering what the product of such combinations can be – this can be described as the true object of a tour through the KES 2012.
